name: Toiro Komachi ~Kurenai ni Somaru Sono Toki made~
original_name: といろ小町～紅に染まるそのときまで～
source:
Toiromachi is a small mountainous town by the sea that's slightly distanced from the big city. The story begins in a long-standing restaurant in the heart of its shopping district called "Murasaki", which serves eel dishes.

The restaurant is flourishing thanks to the happily married couple that run it; the proprietress is popular in the neighborhood while the skills of the restaurant owner, who is also her husband, are well-regarded. Their only daughter and this story's protagonist is a normal university student you'd find anywhere. She doesn't have anything in particular she wants to do and is spending her summer holidays mulling over what to do for her next part-time job.

One day however, her hardworking mother collapses and the protagonist becomes Murasaki's substitute proprietress! In the middle of summer, a highly profitable period, she's made to manage the shop while it's understaffed. Though she's only be covering until her mother is discharged from hospital, a lifestyle completely different from the one she's lead so far has begun!

On top of that, she accidentally finds a single letter addressed to her mother...

"That child... That girl I gave birth to... I wonder if she has been well?"

"I'm not Mom and Dad's child?!"

Confused and bawling her eyes out, a boy suddenly flies down from the sky and appears before her...

As hectic and busy days go by, all of the mysteries gradually unravel. Followed by a strange boy as she navigates the complicated interpersonal relationships between her peers, will this otherwise normal proprietress and student be able to solve the mysteries of her life?

[Translation of [url=http://www.russel.co.jp/hp/gekkahyoujin/toirokomachi/index.html]official website story summary[/url].]
translation:
十色町是一座位於海邊的山間小鎮，與大城市略有距離。故事從商店街中心一家歷史悠久的鰻魚料理店「紫」開始。

經營店鋪的是一對恩愛夫妻，生意一直十分興隆。老闆娘在附近很受歡迎，兼任店主的丈夫則以精湛廚藝廣受好評。他們的獨生女，也是本作主角，只是一名隨處可見的普通大學生。她沒有特別想做的事，暑假裡一直思考下一份打工該找什麼。

然而一天，辛勤工作的母親突然倒下，主角不得不代任「紫」的老闆娘！盛夏正是生意最好的旺季，她卻必須在人手不足的情況下管理店鋪。雖然只需堅持到母親出院，但一種與過去截然不同的生活已經開始！

更何況，她還意外發現了一封寫給母親的信……

「那個孩子……我生下的那個女孩……不知道她過得好不好？」

「我不是爸爸媽媽的孩子？！」

就在她困惑得放聲大哭時，一名少年突然從天而降，出現在面前……

日子就在一片忙亂中過去，所有謎團逐漸解開。面對與同齡人之間錯綜複雜的人際關係，身邊還跟著一名神秘少年，這位原本普通的老闆娘兼大學生能否解開自己人生的謎團？

[翻譯自[url=http://www.russel.co.jp/hp/gekkahyoujin/toirokomachi/index.html]官方網站故事簡介[/url]。]
